name: Example: Harbour Dusk & Starfield
author: Golf Tycoon examples
description: A menu-background mod: two new pictures for Settings > Display > Background (Harbour Dusk and Moonlit Frost), two new overlays (Starfield and a gold club lattice), and a mod-declared overlay setting of its own. Everything is data - no script runs - and because the new pictures are tagged with a season and a course theme, Auto picks them by itself in the right place.
